parts.covers: Recorded toned-milk write-off units (waste) and the days on which waste occurred, to check the premise that waste rose from ₹4,121 to ₹10,810.
parts.sql: select sum("write-offs-june"."units") as "waste_units", count(distinct "write-offs-june"."date") as "waste_days" from "write-offs-june"  where ("write-offs-june"."sku" = ?) limit 1
parts.plan_in_words: From write-off records; keep rows where write offs.sku = 'MILK-TONED-500ML'; report waste_units = sum of write offs.units, waste_days = count distinct of write offs.date.

parts.covers: Toned milk's single recorded selling price and cost per product, used only as a list-margin stand-in; the records hold no shopper identities, no demand, and no record of shoppers who left without buying.
parts.sql: select "products"."price_inr" as "price_inr", "products"."cost_inr" as "cost_inr", "products"."pack" as "pack" from "products"  where ("products"."sku" = ?) limit 1
parts.plan_in_words: From product records; keep rows where products.sku = 'MILK-TONED-500ML'; report price_inr = products.price_inr, cost_inr = products.cost_inr, pack = products.pack.

parts.covers: Uses the stock-change rule (Rule 5: every stock correction has a reason, and mirror-image corrections on lookalike items are one event) to show the atta adjustments by SKU and reason, so the ₹80 net is checked against the gross corrections
parts.sql: select "dc-stock-adjustments-june"."sku" as "sku", "dc-stock-adjustments-june"."reason" as "reason", count(*) as "adjustment_rows", sum("dc-stock-adjustments-june"."units") as "units_adjusted", sum("dc-stock-adjustments-june"."cases") as "cases_adjusted", sum("dc-stock-adjustments-june"."value_at_cost_inr") as "value_at_cost_inr" from "dc-stock-adjustments-june"  where ("dc-stock-adjustments-june"."sku" in (?,?,?)) group by "dc-stock-adjustments-june"."sku", "dc-stock-adjustments-june"."reason" order by "value_at_cost_inr" desc limit 200
parts.plan_in_words: From warehouse (DC) stock adjustment records; keep rows where dc stock adjustments.sku in ['ATTA-WW-10KG', 'ATTA-WW-1KG', 'ATTA-WW-5KG']; group by dc stock adjustments.sku, dc stock adjustments.reason; report sku = dc stock adjustments.sku, reason = dc stock adjustments.reason, adjustment_rows = count of *, units_adjusted = sum of dc stock adjustments.units, cases_adjusted = sum of dc stock adjustments.cases, value_at_cost_inr = sum of dc stock adjustments.value_at_cost_inr; sorted by value_at_cost_inr desc.
